split_method: Multivariate hypergeometric partition without replacement. Save selection and evaluation counts explicitly.
rng_method: Separate deterministic generators derived from SHA-256 of model, seed, operation and identifiers; independent of execution order.
resampling: Independent multinomial reference and detection draws with replacement within the appropriate pool.
score: Mean TV distance across selected inputs
selection: Rank individual inputs by mean selection AUC over the chosen training variants; retain the top three.
evaluation: Evaluate all variants of the test family; average variant AUCs equally.

variant_budget_curve.sizes: 1 through the number of training variants
variant_budget_curve.subsets: All combinations at each size; no random subsampling of variant combinations.
variant_budget_curve.summary: Average equally across training-variant combinations within each seed, then summarize across seeds.

entropy_analysis: Spearman correlation between unchanged selection-pool entropy and individual-input selection AUC, using all variants of each training family. Descriptive analysis on ten inputs; no causal claim.
comparisons: Recompute all strategies on the new evaluation pools. Do not combine with previous experiment AUCs.
cost_scope: Detection observations only; discovery, selection and reference collection excluded.
limitations: Repeated partitions of the same recorded outputs
Descriptive seed SD, not confidence intervals
Supplementary experiment designed after earlier results
